verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents its own testing capability: after-response scripting (insomnia-docs-37), automated collection test runs (insomnia-docs-4), importing tests from Postman (insomnia-docs-40), and running tests in CI via Inso CLI with pass/fail exit codes (insomnia-docs-53, insomnia-docs-39). However, no item explicitly shows assertion syntax or assertions against response status, body, or headers, so how deep the assertion support goes is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an assertion API (e.g. expect/test functions), evidence of status, body and header assertions specifically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
